WHERE (c)-[:foundedBy]->(:Person {name: 'Gunnar Hordvik'})
   OR (c)-[:subsidiaryOf]->(:Company {name: 'EMI'})

MATCH (parent:Company)-[:hasCEO]->(ceo:Person {name: 'Makoto Uchida'}),
      (child:Company {name: 'Nissan New Zealand'})-[:subsidiaryOf]->(parent)
RETURN parent.name AS companyName

MATCH (c:Company)
WHERE ( (c)-[:hasBoardMember]->(:Person {name: "Gerald Hassell"}) )
   OR ( (c)-[:foundedBy]->(:Person {name: "Ralph J. Roberts"}) )
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS companyCount

MATCH (c:Company)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p:Person {name: "Gerald Johnson"}),
      (c)-[:operatesIn]->(i:Industry {name: "mechanical engineering"})
RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS companyName, c.launch_year AS launchYear

MATCH (c:Company)
WHERE (
        toLower(c.name) CONTAINS toLower('Fresenius Kabi')
        AND EXISTS {
            MATCH (c)-[:basedIn]->(co:Country)
            WHERE toLower(co.name) CONTAINS toLower('United States')
               OR any(a IN co.aliases WHERE toLower(a) CONTAINS toLower('United States'))
        }
    )
   OR toLower(c.name) CONTAINS toLower('Plaza & Janés')
RETURN c.name AS company, c.launch_year AS launch_year
ORDER BY toInteger(c.launch_year) DESC
LIMIT 1

MATCH (c:Company)-[:operatesIn]->(i:Industry)
WHERE toLower(i.name) CONTAINS 'footwear' OR any(a IN i.aliases WHERE toLower(a) CONTAINS 'footwear')
MATCH (c)-[:foundedBy]->(p:Person)
RETURN c.name AS company, p.name AS founder, p.gender AS gender

MATCH (parent:Company)<-[:subsidiaryOf]-(sub:Company {name: 'Novo Nordisk (Germany)'})
RETURN parent.name AS companyName

MATCH (c:Company)-[:foundedBy]->(p:Person)
      MATCH (c)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p)
WHERE date(p.date_of_death) > date('1940-05-05')
RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS name

MATCH (c:Company)
WHERE (c)-[:foundedBy]->(:Person {name: 'Sergey Brin'})
   OR (c)<-[:subsidiaryOf]-(:Company {name: 'Jambool'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS companyCount

MATCH (parent:Company {name: "Liberty Media"})<-[:subsidiaryOf]-(c:Company)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p:Person)
RETURN c.name AS companyName, count(DISTINCT p) AS boardMemberCount
ORDER BY companyName

MATCH (c:Company)-[:hasCEO]->(p:Person)
WHERE c.name = "Mercedes-AMG" OR "Mercedes-AMG" IN c.aliases
RETURN p.name AS ceo_name, p.description AS ceo_description, p.date_of_birth AS birth_date, p.date_of_death AS death_date

MATCH (c:Company)
WHERE ( (c)-[:subsidiaryOf]->(:Company {name: 'HSBC'}) )
   OR ( (c)-[:basedIn]->(:Country {name: 'Singapore'}) )
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS companyCount

MATCH (c:Company)-[:basedIn]->(co:Country {name: "United States of America"}),
      (c)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p:Person {name: "Hiro Kamezawa"})
RETURN c.name AS companyName, c.launch_year AS launchYear

MATCH (parent:Company {name: 'Sirius XM'})<-[:subsidiaryOf]-(sub:Company)-[:foundedBy]->(p:Person)
RETURN p.name AS founder, count(DISTINCT sub) AS companiesFounded
ORDER BY companiesFounded DESC

MATCH (sub:Company)-[:subsidiaryOf]->(parent:Company {name: "EMI"})-[:basedIn]->(c:Country)
RETURN c.name AS country, count(sub) AS companyCount
ORDER BY companyCount DESC

WITH person
MATCH (c:Company)-[:hasCEO]->(person)
RETURN person.name AS personName, count(DISTINCT c) AS numCompanies
ORDER BY personName

MATCH (c:Company)-[:basedIn]->(country:Country {name: "Russia"})
MATCH (c)-[:hasBoardMember]->(person:Person)
RETURN person.name AS personName, count(DISTINCT c) AS companyCount

MATCH (ag:Company) WHERE toLower(ag.name) CONTAINS toLower('Agrofert')
MATCH (ag)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p:Person)
MATCH (c:Company)-[:hasCEO]->(p)
WHERE c <> ag
RETURN c.name AS company,
       count(DISTINCT p) AS ceo_board_member_count
ORDER BY ceo_board_member_count DESC

MATCH (cFounded:Company)-[:foundedBy]->(p)

UNWIND citizenships AS citizenship
RETURN DISTINCT citizenship AS country_of_citizenship

MATCH (c:Company)-[:foundedBy]->(p:Person),
      (c)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p)
WHERE NOT ('Austria' IN coalesce(p.country_of_citizenship, []))
RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS individual_name
